# Chargement des données labels

```{r}

path <- "datas"
labels <- fread(paste(path, 'RT_labels.csv', sep = '/'), data.table = F, sep = ";",  header = TRUE, index = FALSE)
labels

```



```{r}
names(labels)
summary(labels)

```


```{r}

for(i in 1:length(names(labels))){
  hist(labels[[i]], breaks = min(50, length(unique(labels[[i]]))), main = colnames(labels)[i], xlab = names(labels)[i])
}

```

```{r}

sapply(labels, class)
labels[, c(1)] <- as.factor(labels[, c(1)])
labels[, c(8)] <- as.numeric(labels[, c(8)])
labels[, c(9)] <- as.numeric(labels[, c(9)])
sapply(labels, class)

```
```{r}



```




```{r}
           # number area length thickness slant width height mu_x mu_y sigma_x sigma_y 
effectifs <- c(10,   7,    7,       5,      5,    5,    5,     5,  5,    5,       5)
data_disc <- discretize(
  labels,
  method  = "hartemink",
  breaks  = effectifs,
  ibreaks = 20
)


for(i in 1:10){
  barplot(table(data_disc[[i]]), main = colnames(labels)[i])
}

names(data_disc)
# rm(labels)
# rm(morpho.mnist)

```

Get Chow Liu E graph
 
```{r}

library(bnlearn)
library(infotheo)

# 1. Discrétisation initiale grossière
d0 <- bnlearn::discretize(data, method = "equalfreq", breaks = effectifs)

# 2. Apprentissage de l’arbre de Chow–Liu
E <- chow.liu(d0)

# 3. Discrétisation Hartemink guidée par ce graphe
d <- discretize(data, method = "hartemink", breaks = 3)

```
